options.name: commissioning_file
options.description: Default local path of the service commissioning file for all items. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Default flag for enabling or disabling services after installation. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: items
options.description: Services to manage. Each item uses the same service-specific fields as C(cybus.connectware.service).

options.name: max_concurrent
options.description: Maximum number of service operations to run concurrently. This limits worker threads in this module. Automatically limited to 1 when the target Connectware is below 2.4.2 or its version cannot be determined, because parallel service deployments can corrupt services on affected versions. Set C(cybus_parallel_service_protection = false) in the C([defaults]) section of C(ansible.cfg) to disable this protection.

options.name: parameters
options.description: Default parameters for all items. Merged with per-item parameters; item keys take precedence.

options.name: state
options.description: Default target state for Connectware Services. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: target_hostname
options.description: Used to connect to the Connectware API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Flag to enable Connectware certificate checking.
